question: Which office may register, change and remove an external SAML or OIDC identity provider for an organization, how is the organization shown to own the identity domain the provider asserts, and which provider groups may confer which tenant roles?
decision: Org admins may register a SAML or OIDC provider, but it stays disabled until DNS TXT domain ownership is proven and a platform staff member reviews it. autoProvision defaults to false. Group-to-role mapping may confer only member or steward; higher roles are granted in-app.
